GS.rationale: Goldman Sachs shows strong fundamental health and positive trajectory. Q1 2026 revenue grew 14.4% YoY to $17.23B with EPS of $17.55 (+24.3% YoY), and the Q2 2026 earnings call (July 14) revealed record quarterly revenue of $20.3B and EPS of $20.98, with ROE of 23.5%. The firm is executing well across segments: Global Banking & Markets revenue hit $15.5B (+53% YoY), equities produced record $7.4B, and Asset & Wealth Management grew 20% YoY with record $4T in assets under supervision. Net margin improved to 29.9% and ROE to 14.7% (trailing). The firm announced a 25% dividend increase and $4B buyback. However, valuation has expanded significantly: P/E of 18.7x is near the top of its 14.5-19.6x 1-year range, and P/B of 2.75x is at the high end of 1.8-2.9x. The stock has rallied 21.8% in the past quarter to $1,095, which partially prices in the strong results. Operating cash flow is volatile and was negative $31.9B in Q1, typical for a bank but worth noting. The Oppenheimer downgrade on July 9 citing 'priced for perfection' valuations is a cautionary signal. Balance sheet leverage remains high (debt-to-equity ~4.9x per web context). The near-term catalyst of the Q2 beat is now largely priced in after the 7.4% post-earnings pop. Macro backdrop is mixed: Fed funds at 3.63% with hawkish signals, 10Y yield at 4.57%, and VIX at 16.7 suggests moderate risk appetite. Score reflects excellent trajectory and franchise quality offset by stretched valuation after a strong run.

Valuation stretched: P/E 18.7x near top of 1-year range (14.5-19.6x), P/B 2.75x at high end (1.8-2.9x)
Stock up 21.8% in past quarter, partially pricing in strong results
25% dividend increase and $4B buyback signal capital return confidence
Leading M&A advisor with $1.2T announced deal volumes in H1 2026, AI/infrastructure tailwinds
Record $4T assets under supervision with 34 consecutive quarters of long-term net inflows
Oppenheimer downgrade to underperform on July 9 citing 'priced for perfection'
High leverage (debt-to-equity ~4.9x) and 100% external funding per web context
Hawkish Fed signals and elevated 10Y yields create mixed macro backdrop for financials
